bodyHtml:
🖥️ Your #1 Choice For Computer Help · Logan & Surrounds

Computer Repairs Logan. Fast, Honest, Onsite Or Remote.

Choosing a computer technician can feel daunting, there are so many companies to pick from that most people have no idea where to start. Computer Repairs Logan has been fixing PCs, laptops and Macs for the last 20 years. We've been featured on Channel 9 news, and our director is a Microsoft Certified Professional who was previously the youngest employee for IBM in Australia.

Fix My Computer
✓ 20 Years' Experience
✓ Onsite, Remote & Drop-Off
✓ 7 Days A Week
✓ Featured On Channel 9
Your #1 Choice

Computer Help And Technical Support, Done Properly.

We find that most people are grateful to a technician who helps them out and goes over and above, and that's exactly what we aim for on every job. If you have a laptop or Mac problem and already know what's wrong, get in touch with the details and we'll give you a straight quote before we book anything in.

PC & Hardware Upgrades

Not Just Repairs, Upgrades And Setup Too.

Looking for a PC upgrade or to swap the hard drive in a Mac? We can install your new hardware, make sure your network is set up properly, and get a brand-new computer fully configured before we leave. Need a laptop or MacBook repair? We do that too.

Our Services

Everything Your Computer Needs, Under One Roof.

We offer more than 40 different types of IT services across Logan, here are some of the most requested.

🛠️

Computer Repair

No need to wait a week, our technicians don't take long to find out what's troubling your computer.

⚡

Computer Speed Up

Your computer needs a tune-up as regularly as your car does. It removes annoying bloatware and improves performance.

📈

Computer Upgrade

System hanging or complaining of low disk space? You might just need an upgrade, not a whole new machine.

🛡️

Virus Removal

Onsite virus removal, plus guidance on installing and updating anti-virus software.

🔒

Internet Security

You often can't tell if your computer's already a victim of an attack, that's what certified technicians are for.

💾

File Recovery

Back up your files before you lose them, or let us recover data you've already lost.

🔌

Setup New Device

New webcam or printer? We connect and configure nearly all peripheral devices for you.

🖥️

New Computer Setup

Buying a new computer should be exciting, not stressful, we'll come to you and set it up onsite.

Best Prices, Best Service

Onsite, Online Or Drop-Off, Your Choice.

We're your local Logan store for computer repairs, and we can do it all.

  • Onsite & remote support. Many software issues can be fixed remotely, no need to leave home.
  • 7 days a week. A problem doesn't wait for business hours, and neither do we.
  • Free advice after you become a customer. We don't disappear once the invoice is paid.
  • Insurance reports. Storm, electrical or water damage on your laptop or Mac? We can help with insurance reports too.
What Our Customers Say

Real Reviews From Real Customers.

"Really happy with the service. Unfortunately my PC had come to the end of its life. Got helpful advice on a replacement to meet my computing needs. Will use these guys again in the future."

"Having dealt with a number of questionable repair people, I was shocked at how quick, flexible and affordable these guys were."

"I felt the technician was really thorough, solved a lot of my issues remotely on the same day, and had patience with getting the remote session set up."

Related Services

Not Sure Exactly What's Wrong?

If it's a laptop specifically, our laptop repairs page covers the most common faults. Mac or MacBook owners should check out Apple Mac repairs. If you already suspect a hardware fault, like a failing hard drive or overheating, our hardware repair & diagnostics service digs deeper. And if it's a virus or malware slowdown, see virus & spyware removal. Lost files as part of the problem? We also do data recovery.

Ready To Get Your Computer Sorted?

Call Computer Repairs Logan or fill out the quote form and we'll take it from there.

Fix My Computer
Where We Work

Service Areas.

We repair computers across Logan, and dispatch technicians widely across South East Queensland.

Not sure if we cover your area? Get in touch and ask.

Get Your Computer Fixed Today.

Drop off, book an onsite visit, or connect remotely, whatever suits you best.
